Wrote the handoff to `INCIDENT_HANDOFF.md`.

One thing to flag: there's no `package-lock.json` in this checkout, so I couldn't confirm the exact installed ioredis version. `package.json` only pins a range, `^5.4.1`. I noted that in the doc and left a follow-up to pull the real version from the deployed `node_modules` or build artifact before checking the changelog.

Root cause and the 02:14–02:31 impact window are both in there, same story as before: Redis dropped and never reconnected, the backlog piled up, and it ended in an OOM crash and full outage.
